note: The next few days look like they could weigh on you more than usual — your sleep has dipped and your resting heart rate has crept up. That is a common pattern when caregiving gets heavier. It might be a good moment to line up a little support before things pile up.

programs.name: ARCH National Respite Locator
programs.why: Your sleep is slipping — a few hours of respite care could give you a real break.

programs.name: National Caregiver Help Desk
programs.why: A free, person-to-person help desk to talk through what you need right now.

crisis_note: If you are in crisis or thinking about harming yourself, call or text 988 anytime.
